title: Watchface, widget and notifications take time to update
symptom: When AAPS receives xDrip's data it updates, but widget, watchface and notification take time to update (sometimes 1-3 minutes, watchface even 15-20 minutes). This causes discrepancy between xDrip alarm and watch value.
cause: The issue was resolved by checking how much user data the app has stored, as suggested in issue #2036.
fix: Check how much user data the app has stored, as per issue #2036. The user confirmed that it worked.
evidence_quote: That sounds sort of similar to what I was experiencing. Might be worth checking how much user data the app has stored? See #2036
